items.title: Copying the invite link crashed when the phone blocks clipboard access
Co-parent could see the other household's relatives in Circles
Notification preview always said 'Chase shared photos of Mia'
Choosing an empty circle said 'Pick at least one circle'
Grandparents saw a dead Share button and gaps in the tab bar
A half-typed comment was wiped when anyone reacted
Duplicate circle names were allowed
Share sheet's default audience carried over between people
Sheets didn't take focus or close with Escape
Hidden tabs reappeared outside the artifact preview (CSS beat the hidden attribute). Found by ROLE-01 during the fix run.
Delete your own post, with a confirm step
Tap a photo for full screen, swipe or arrow between photos
Invite flow: name, role and circles chosen up front, then a link to text
'Seen by 3 of 5' on your own posts
Larger text setting for grandparents
Remove a picked photo before sharing
Rename and delete circles; deleting is blocked if a post would lose its only audience
Removing someone from a circle says how many posts they lost
Test selector also matched the Share tab (shared 'post' class). Renamed the tab's class in the app and tightened the test.
Blocked web fonts were counted as script errors in tests
pick.test used a dynamic import, which Jest can't run without VM modules; switched to a static import
Time-zone tests set process.env.TZ, which Jest's sandbox ignores, so no-offset dates were read as UTC. The phone's zone is now an explicit option (default from Intl)

Flaky: bulk.test 'Send makes 5 posts' checked the whole fake backend for /GPS|Apple/ including random base64 ciphertext, which sometimes spells 'GPS' (failed 3 of 4 full runs, 1 of 5 alone). Now checks everything except the encrypted blobs; EXIF in the bytes is checked before encryption by the pipeline tests
Someone removed from the family space kept access to their own old posts: new comments, photos and keys
A view-only member could publish a draft after posting was turned off for viewers
A video labeled as a photo slipped past the 10-video free cap
Co-parent could read billing details and the space's video count
Co-parent could see a child linked to the other household (e.g. a new half-sibling) with nothing shared
Children's birth dates were readable by all members
Could edit your comment on a post you can no longer see
Edge function failed type-checking on current Deno, so the documented test command didn't run
Space managers can read invite code hashes; 8-character codes are crackable offline in about a day. Salt or lengthen codes.
No rate limit on redeeming invite codes
A guardian can unlink their child from the other household's space
Removed members can still edit captions on their old posts
Members of a deleted circle can still see each other's profiles
Free-tier video cap is per space; someone can make extra spaces (fixed Oct 29: counted per person, migration 0020)
Media can be marked ready without its key saved, which breaks that post (fails closed)
Rerun the backend suite on a real Supabase stack before launch (today's runs use a stand-in)
Filter the feed by child (tag Mia / Leo on a post)
Save a photo to your phone (grandparents print them)
Undo for 10 seconds after deleting a post
Tell people about the 60-second video limit and free-tier video count when they pick a video
Invite status: joined or pending, plus resend and cancel
Upload progress and automatic retry on bad cell signal
Multilingual app (Spanish first)
Send a circle's photos to a smart frame
Notification sender: outbox (0003) plus the notify function (Expo Push + Resend), 1-minute cron
First real-device pass on Chase's iPhone: resize, EXIF scan (M-09), encrypted upload, save to phone, code sign-in
Publish to Expo Go as an EAS Update (branch preview) and the web build
'Take me off Hearth' for non-owners (BETA-JOIN-7)
TestFlight external submission (milestone 3, after the name is final)
Our own error reports, fixed fields only, 30 days (0006, BETA-OPS-1)
S12: removed members can't edit their old captions (0005, BETA-REPLY-4)
Video posting: off until location can be stripped from video too (BETA-SPEC). Oct 29: stripping built (FLAG-7 auto); poster frame, player and iPhone check left (TRACKER R27)
BETA-REPLY-1, deferred in BETA-SPEC
The invite rate limit kept raw IP addresses, and the last ones could stay forever. Now a keyed hash, purged daily, pepper replaced daily (0012)
Nothing stopped a log line from printing a key, URL or caption; sign-media logged raw error messages. CI log check added
Sent-vs-received check for the milestone 1 gate's '0 lost' (backend/scripts/sent-vs-received.sh)
Read-only smoke check of the hosted project (D1; backend/scripts/smoke-check.sh)
Photos with no EXIF date take the photo library's creation time, with no new permission prompt
Contract test BETA-TIME-4 failed on the real-API harness (also on main): BETA-TIME-2 had made a 2019 post in the same database. It now uses years no other test uses
Test Log builder gave every backend suite's case 1 the same id (SQL-001), so later suites overwrote earlier ones. Ids are now per suite

In Expo Go, keys could come from Math.random: expo-crypto's getRandomBytes falls back to it in dev builds. Hit photo keys, the local-storage key and chat keys. Now getRandomValues only, and it fails rather than fall back (MS4 tests)
Photos encrypted in Expo Go before the S17 fix may have guessable keys. Milestone 1 test data only; clear the test bucket before any real family photos go in
Messenger has no key check (safety numbers): a compromised server could add a hidden phone to a chat (MS4)
Outside review of app/src/messenger/mlsCrypto.ts, our own HPKE and ciphersuite glue around audited libraries (not audited)
Messenger crypto has no RFC 9180 known-answer vectors, and export is interop-tested in one direction only
QA-3 sent_received_test fails when run on 2026-10-19: seed posts dated that day land in its 'since today' window (also on main)
The fake backend's chatFetch has no joined-at cutoff, so app tests don't cover 'newcomers can't fetch older chat rows' (SQL tests do)
HARD-12: members could write reactions straight through PostgREST, skipping the three-emoji list and 'replies off' (a free-text side channel). Migration 0018
HARD-13: the cached feed (captions, names, reactions) stayed on the phone after sign out
HARD-14: a reaction summary read before a tap can land after it and hide the confirmed reaction until the next refresh
HARD-15: Fake and Supabase disagree on reacting to your own unpublished post (the contract doesn't cover it)
HARD-17: Postgres JIT-compiled feed_rows once a family had a few dozen posts: 1.5-2 s per Photos or By date page instead of 20-50 ms. Migration 0018 turns JIT off for it
HARD-16: on a server before 0017, Haha or Like takes away an existing heart (the hosted server has 0017)
LIVE-1: on iPhone the glass tab bar drew the 17 pt tab words over the icons (Chase's live review, Nov 5)

npm run e2e:web can't launch a browser in the cloud sandbox: e2e's Playwright 1.56.1 wants chromium_headless_shell-1194, /opt/pw-browsers has 1243. VID-18's red run used a local wrapper config pointing launchOptions.executablePath at 1243
QA-R3: on the web the picker reports 0 s when it can't read a video's metadata; pickedDurationMs turns that into 0 ms, which passes the 60 s limit. Test: media/__tests__/pickDurationZero.test.ts

Test Log honesty: run r11 (Oct 18) is rebuilt from today's SQL files, so every rebuild marks backend cases written after Oct 18 as passing in a run that never ran them (639 became 841 on Nov 10). Those two seed files were left as committed until it's fixed

QA-R1 (OPEN-5): Photos saves the last visit as now as soon as it loads, even when the feed never loads (no network). Photos that came before that offline open never get a New for you card. Spec gap: OPEN-5 doesn't say; needs staff-pm's call, then a failing test. Fixed in bb09bdd (GUX-R4: saved only after the first good load, as its start time). Tests: screens/__tests__/opening.test.tsx OPEN-5 QA-R1 (2), feed/__tests__/store.test.ts OPEN-5 QA-R1 fetchedAt

QA-R2 (OPEN-1/7/8): New for you only looks at the posts already loaded (the first page of 20). With more than 20 new posts since the last visit, the card's senders and the one-at-a-time view leave out the oldest new ones and don't start at the oldest. EF-HE-9 (intake #162, Nov 24): fixed at 88e605c by FeedStore.loadBackTo; with B26 fixed at d8115ee, closed by run r71 (green 3x). Tests: evalFindings.test.tsx, feed/__tests__/loadBackTo.test.ts

QA-R1 (eval findings run r76, Nov 24): a refresh that answers while a loadMore page (a scroll, or B18's loadBackTo walk) is in flight lets the stale page append after the new first page: with 6 new posts on the server the feed skips 6 posts between the first page and the old page 2, and later pages continue from the bottom, so the hole stays until the next refresh. New for you can undercount the same way. Fixed at d8115ee (a refresh generation: loadMorePage drops a page started before the latest refresh, loadBackTo walks on from the new first page); closed by run r71 (green 3x). Test: app/src/feed/__tests__/loadBackTo.test.ts 'a refresh that lands mid-walk'

QA-R3 (OPEN-1): Ruth's half of the privacy pair only checks a card exists, not that it holds the Mom's side post; and no OPEN-10 case for exactly 20 posts (no Show older photos). Fixed: Ruth's card now opens on the Mom's side post (2f08ef5); OPEN-10 T14 exactly one page added to screens/__tests__/opening.test.tsx

QA-R1 (RD-7, OPEN-4/OPEN-7): after redesign 1a the opening tests' FILLED now means the accent-tinted capsule (accentSoft), but their titles and comments still say "filled" and "filled full-width Next". The guarantee holds (redesignLint RD-7 bans stray primary/danger buttons app-wide); only the names mislead. Rename to "highlighted" in screens/__tests__/opening.test.tsx

QA-R1 (redesign 1b, RD-9/RD-10): the hosted demo's cold loads of /demo/hearth/groups and /demo/hearth/me show no app (no Demo details, no Hearth) because 1b removed those routes and only /photos redirects (to /gallery). e2e:site DEMO-5 is red for both, so the demo-site workflow's pre-upload check would stop the deploy, and old links people saved break. Fix: redirect /groups and /me (likely to /more), or retire them from DEMO-5's list on staff-pm's word. Test: app/e2e-web/site.spec.js DEMO-5. Fixed (e6312e2): /groups, /me, /help redirect to More with that row open; e2e:site DEMO-5 green 3x (r28)

QA-R1 (redesign 1c, PERF-FEED-1): flaky. e2e-web/perf.spec.js now taps the Gallery tab and reloads straight away; on 1 of 3 runs page.reload failed with net::ERR_ABORTED (frame detached), most likely because the tab's own navigation was still in flight. Wait for the Gallery greeting heading (or the URL) after the tap, before the timing loop. Fixed (r29): perf.spec.js now waits for the /gallery URL and the Good morning/afternoon/evening heading after the Gallery tap, before the timing loop; PERF-FEED-1 passed 3 of 3 e2e:web runs

QA-R2 (B19): screens/__tests__/oldTabLinks.test.tsx and site.spec.js DEMO-5 only check that Back to More shows, not which row opened, so /help opening Me (or /groups opening Help) would still pass. Also assert the row's heading (Your groups, Me, Help), and that a parent's /groups shows a group name (the allowed half of DEC-49). Fixed (r29): oldTabLinks.test.tsx asserts the opened row's heading (Your groups, Me, Help), that the other two are absent, and that a parent's /groups shows a group name; site.spec.js DEMO-5 checks the same headings on cold loads. Mutation check: /help opening Me fails it

QA-R3 (RD-18 privacy pair): in screens/__tests__/redesignGallery.test.tsx Ruth's half uses arrayContaining(Mom's side media), so a Dad's side tile leaking into Ruth's grid would still pass. Jo's half is exact. Add: Ruth's grid holds none of the Dad's side post's media. Fixed (r29): Ruth's half of the RD-18 pair in redesignGallery.test.tsx now asserts her grid is exactly the Mom's side post's media and holds none of the Dad's side post's media

QA-R1 (review round 1 gate): backend/tests/notify_test.sql #29 'prefs: push wanted but no phone registered -> falls back to the evening email' is a time bomb. It creates the post at now() and claims at a fixed 2026-11-16 18:30 America/New_York with no tests.queued_at, so since Nov 16 23:30 UTC the notice is newer than the claim clock and the test fails every run (3/3 on Nov 17; backend unchanged on the branch). Fix: call tests.queued_at('2026-11-16 17:00 America/New_York') before the claim, like the other NOTIFY-5 cases. Not a product bug. Fixed (r35): #29 now calls tests.queued_at('2026-11-16 17:00 America/New_York') before the 18:30 claim; same assertion; backend green 3x

QA-R1 (review round 2 red run, Nov 17): flaky. src/ui/__tests__/familyColor.test.tsx 'RD-24 / RD-25 the owner picks Forest...' failed in 1 of 3 full jest runs (run 2) and passed 3 of 3 alone; untouched by the round 2 tests. Likely a findBy/waitFor timeout under full-suite load. Find the slow wait and give it an explicit timeout or await the saved prefs

QA-R1 (RD-83 red run, Nov 17): vacuous test. app/src/screens/__tests__/reviewRound2.test.tsx R18 'each month title is a sticky header' finds the content container with scroll.findAll(isHost)[0], which is the scroll itself, so kids[1] is the whole content and every month reads as sticky. With the content-container lookup the engineer used in searchBacking.test.tsx the check reads sticky:false for both months, because the titles stick by translateY, not stickyHeaderIndices. Rewrite R18 on behavior (pinnedBlock.test.tsx RD-83 offsets) or fix the helper; the R18 e2e allows 24 px of slack and missed the 17 px gap RD-83 catches. Fixed (r42): R18 rewritten on behavior (title top under the bar at 4 scroll points, next month scrolls with its photos); red with the phone translateY removed

QA-R1 (themes green run, Nov 18): app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js RD-102 polled the backing of a 'More' heading after picking a theme, but the pick happens on the Theme screen, which has no More heading, so it timed out 3/3 while the page had already recolored (probe: Avocado light rgb(238, 239, 211)). Fixed (r46): read the Theme heading's backing (themeBg); e2e:demo 25 passed x3

QA-R1 (warm paper red run, Nov 18): app/src/__tests__/portfolioClaims.test.ts RD-1 fails at 81d021d before any new test: docs/portfolio/CASE-STUDY.md says 57 decisions, the log has 67 (DEC-67), more than 10 behind. Fix: update the case study count. Test: app/src/__tests__/portfolioClaims.test.ts

QA-R1 (share postcard red run, Nov 19): 16 more test files drive the old Share page (Pick photos from your phone, What's happening?, Title (optional), Post) and will go red when DEC-73 lands: jest features, wordsPass, captions, problemDetails, uploadFailure, plainBackground, guxPaper (GUX-R16 fields), reviewRound2 (Share insets), familyShape; e2e-web core-loop, demo-screens, video, showcase, perf, demo-showcase, snapshot. Retarget them to the postcard (note, face tile, Send to) with the engineer's build. Tests: those files. Fixed (r50): retargeted in the build commit and reviewed by qa-tdd (no weakening found); jest, e2e:web and e2e:demo green x3

QA-R1 (share postcard green run, Nov 19): the screenshot specs only run with SNAPSHOT_DIR / SHOWCASE_DIR set, so they rot unseen. With them set: app/e2e-web/showcase.spec.js (4) and snapshot.spec.js (2) pass the DEC-73 Share steps, then fail waiting for the caption 'Pumpkin patch' on Grandma Jo's Gallery (Gallery shows no captions; photo labels are now 'Open photo from Chase, <date>'); demo-screens.spec.js and demo-showcase.spec.js (4) fail at their first step, 'Bridge walk on the trail' on Gallery, before Share. Gallery is unchanged on this branch, so stale from an earlier Gallery redesign. Fix: wait on Feed or the photo button instead of caption text on Gallery; consider a CI job that runs them. Tests: those files

QA-R1 (Hass Avocado run, Nov 20): 3 tests still assumed GUX-R15's filled picked capsule, superseded by DEC-76 / SPEC-REDESIGN 1k. Retargeted: moments.test.tsx LIVE-3 now expects a 2 pt outline and no fill (RD-114); warmPaper.test.tsx RD-89 compares padding + border per side, since RD-116 absorbs the 1 to 2 pt border change in padding; reviewRound2.test.tsx R21 had the border sign wrong (the emoji starts after margin + border + padding), so it read 14 instead of 16. jest green x3 on those

QA-R2 (Hass Avocado run, Nov 20): flaky, unrelated to DEC-76. app/src/screens/__tests__/smsSignIn.test.tsx BETA-SMS-4 'names only the last 4 digits...' failed in jest run 2 of 3: it reads 'You can ask for a new code in (60|59) seconds.' on real timers, and under full-suite load more than a second passes, so it shows 58 or less. Fix: fake timers before sending the code (as the 61 s check below it does), or accept 5x. Fixed Nov 20 (qa-tdd): the test now runs on jest fake timers, reads exactly 60, advances 1 s and reads 59 (proves the countdown). Red shown with 2.1 s of simulated load (58 seconds): e2e/results/t26-sms4-red-2026-11-20.txt. Test: that file

QA-R1 (T26 fix run, Nov 20): under 3x CPU oversubscription (8 busy loops on 4 cores) the full jest run failed app/src/screens/__tests__/oldTabLinks.test.tsx B19 '/me opens More -> Me for a parent and a viewer' once: a queryByRole header that should be null found a View. Not seen in 3 normal runs. Likely cause: the loop renders twice (chase then jo) and the second render is read before the first unmount settles, or More opens a row after a load. Check under load before calling it fixed. Test: that file

QA-R1 (DEC-78 font green run, Nov 21): app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js RD-117/RD-116 timed out on 'More' tab in all 3 demo runs with the Atkinson font, passed at 8a118b3 without it. Cause: the taller lines put the heart lower, so tapping it scrolls Feed and the glass bar shrinks to 'Feed, show all tabs' (RD-110, intended); pick() assumed the full bar. Fixed Nov 21 (qa-tdd): pick() taps the shrunk oval first (RD-110-R1). Red and green in e2e/results/font-green-2026-11-21.txt. Test: that file

QA-R1 (Share start B+ green run r56, Nov 23): app/src/screens/__tests__/video.test.tsx VID-21 finds the Add photos target by /^Add photos( or videos)?, up to 100 at a time$/ although the test turns video_posting on, so a regression to the plain 'Add photos' label with videos on would pass. Pin the exact 'Add photos or videos, up to 100 at a time' (SHARE-ST-2). Test: that file

Fruit themes green phase (DEC-80, Nov 23): app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js RD-102/FRUIT-11 toGallery and pick tapped the Gallery/More tab while scrolling the 10-row Theme list had shrunk the glass bar (RD-110), so the tab click timed out on Fig. Fix: restore the bar first (the T28 'show all tabs' tap) in both helpers; no expectation changed. Test: that file

QA-R1 (BETA-SMS): a phone-only account's placeholder name falls back to its phone number (tg_handle_new_user, 0007: coalesce(email, phone)), so the family would see the number as a name and in notices. Test: backend/tests/sms_test.sql

QA-R6 (Share start final green run r57, Nov 23): on Share start a parent's To: group names (GUX-R3, 2 lines) still end with '…' after 2 lines when the family has many groups, so the last groups are cut off with no way to see them on that line. Not covered by a test yet (SHARE-ST-15 checks only 3 groups). Where: app/src/screens/ShareScreen.tsx

QA-R2 (DEMO-SAFARI green gate, Nov 21): e2e:demo RD-117 failed 1 of 3 with page.reload: Not attached to an active page, because the DEMO-SAFARI fix made Reset wait for saves before navigating and resetDemo() returned at the click. Fixed Nov 21: resetDemo() waits for 'Sample data restored.'; demo.spec.js 3x green (102/102). Test: app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js

QA-R3 (DEMO-SAFARI green gate, Nov 21): Reset demo clears localStorage but leaves photo bytes in IndexedDB (hearth.demoObjects) until the next load starts a fresh family. Local only, nothing leaves the device. Fix: startOver() clears the store before navigating. No test yet.

QA-R1 (dark elevation red run, Nov 23, intake #155): in dark the surface step that now replaces shadows is small: c.surface vs c.bg contrast is 1.078:1 (Paper), 1.114:1 (Avocado), 1.046:1 (Pomegranate), so the laptop phone column and the glass tab bar barely lift off the page in dark (see /mnt/project-files/design/dark-elevation-2026-11-23/after-1280-dark.png). DARK-ELEV-1 only checks lighter (ratio > 1). Design call for grandparent-ux: pick a minimum step and pin it in DARK-ELEV-1. Where: app/src/ui/theme.ts

QA-R2 (dark elevation green run, Nov 23): app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js DARK-ELEV-6 scanned the first screen only, so RD-82's pinned shade line (shown after a scroll) was not checked in a real browser, and light was not checked. (Reported SKIPPED by the engineer: not reproduced; it runs in the only demo project at 390x844; the 5 skipped are the env-gated screenshot specs.) Fixed: explicit 390x844, scroll 300 px and re-scan, shade box-shadow none in dark and set in light. Red on 1341595 (tab bar, then shade line); green x3

app/e2e-web/site.spec.js DEMO-5 'Grandma's view and Start over' raced the now-async Grandma Jo switch (#144): Details opened before the reload finished, so 'You're Grandma Jo' was not found. Failed 3/3 against the live site from the cloud env (passed locally and on CI). Fixed Nov 23: wait for the reloaded 'Good ..., Grandma Jo' heading before Details, and for 'Good ..., Chase' after resetDemo's reload; no expectation weakened. Red 1/8 failed x2, then 8 passed x3 against chaseholroyd.com/hearth. Same pattern still in demo.spec.js (lines ~66, ~318), passing locally. Test: that file

QA-R2 (T33 run, Nov 23): app/e2e-web/site.spec.js DEMO-5 'a cold load of /hearth/groups' failed 1 of 5 runs against the live site (line 43: a failed own request or page error), passed the other 4. Likely a slow or dropped request through the cloud proxy, not reproduced; error text not kept. Next: rerun with --repeat-each 10 and keep the failed list. Test: that file

DEMO-PHOTO swap (Nov 24): app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js UX-R1 opened the walk with '2 new' / 'New photos: 1 of 2' (the old photo set); the newest post is now Alex's 3-photo bike post (DEMO-PHOTO-12), so '3 new' and 'New photos: 1 of 1' (the walk counts posts, as the New-for-you test already asserts). R18 scrolled a fixed 1200 px, which with the new photos lands exactly on the November/October boundary; it now scrolls 200 px into the second month's section, measured from its title. Intent unchanged. Test: that file

Demo-site publish (demo-site.yml run 45430430863, Nov 24) failed its pre-publish check app/e2e-web/site.spec.js: 3 tests still expected the old demo after DEMO-PHOTO (DEC-82). DEMO-5 Start over greeted 'Chase' and read "You're Chase, a parent" (now Kevin, DEMO-PHOTO-10); DEMO-LIVE-2 searched 'lake' (now 'orchard': only post 1's title says it; search reads title, caption, sender); DEMO-NEW-5 walked '1 of 2' then Next to '2 of 2' (now one new post: '1 of 1', the bike title shows, no Next new photo, Done back to Kevin's Gallery, as demo.spec.js asserts). Intent unchanged, no check removed. No other publish or live check named the old demo. Test: that file

QA-R1 (life calendar review green run r68, Nov 24): the birthday privacy line 'Your family will see the month and day. Never the year.' (Gallery card and the Add my birthday form) and 'Saved. Your family will see December 8.' say the whole family sees your birthday. Under PRIV-R2 a member's birthday follows can_see_profile: parents plus people who share a group with you, so in a split family a viewer outside your groups does not see it. Overclaims the audience (safe direction, no leak), but it is untrue and can cause needless worry (A1). Words for grandparent-ux/staff-pm, then a failing test for the new words. 'Only your family can see these.' (subline) and 'It's removed for everyone in the family.' (delete) are accurate. Where: app/src/screens/Birthdays.tsx (PRIVACY, save notice). No test yet.

qa-tdd test bug (life calendar green run, Nov 24): app/src/screens/__tests__/calendar.test.tsx CAL-14 'icon and the word' counted Text nodes for the icon, but the row's icon is a SymbolView, which renders no Text under jest. It stayed red against a correct build (6fd4b91). Fixed: assert a non-chevron SymbolView inside the Birthdays row, as RD-15 does; no expectation weakened (word still checked). Green x3. Test: that file

QA-R1 (VIS review, Nov 24): VIS-7's every-row parity check in backend/tests/vis_core_test.sql reaches only the 13 of 34 kinds with a uuid id. The other 21 (composite keys like post_audience, reaction, media_key, circle_member; bigint ids like chat_message, comment_mode_log) are pinned by name but get no per-row can_see vs RLS comparison; VIS-4 still checks their select policies. Fix: compare those rows through their item/owner column instead of id

Live check (Nov 24): the laptop demo panel's 'Try this' step 3 (app/src/demo/DemoFrame.tsx TRY) still says 'Tap Search and type lake.' After the Kevin/orchard demo (DEC-82) 'lake' finds nothing; 'orchard' finds 1 photo (site.spec.js DEMO-LIVE-2). Failing test first: DEMO-NEW-6, T40 now expects 'Search and type orchard', plus a T40 guard that the hinted word really finds a post in DEMO_POSTS (title, caption or sender name, as demo search reads) so the hint can't drift again. Red, 1 run: 2 failed, 4 passed. Fixed (Nov 24): step 3 now says 'Tap Search and type orchard.'; that file green, 6 passed, typecheck clean. Test: that file

QA-R1 (React Compiler green run r79, Nov 24, intake #80): 24 compiler bailouts in 23 components are allowlisted in app/scripts/compiler-check.js, so they stay uncompiled (exactly the pre-compiler behaviour, not a regression). 10 try/finally or try/catch value blocks, throw in try or new-expression (wait for compiler support or restructure), 9 ref.current reads during render, 2 TimelineScreen manual memo deps that differ from inferred ones, VideoPlayer Playing mutating a hook value, JoinScreen using check before declaration. Follow-up: fix one at a time, each removing its ALLOWED line so INTAKE-80-3 guards it. Where: app/scripts/compiler-check.js ALLOWED. Test: node app/scripts/compiler-check.js

Fixed at 91e424a (fontFamily inline on each stamp Text), FONT-2 green 3x in r71. QA-R1 (wordless Share start gate r70, Nov 24): jest FONT-2 fails 3/3 at 37cbe7f: app/src/ui/kit.tsx:341-342 PostcardStamp renders <Text style={mark}> with fontFamily inside the mark variable, so the kit guard cannot see an Atkinson family. Fix (engineer): put fontFamily: FONT.semibold inline in each stamp Text's style. Test: app/src/ui/__tests__/font.test.tsx

GUX-T2 P1 (PR #174 fix round, Nov 24): Share's empty postcard is vertically centered (ShareScreen styles.emptyWrap justifyContent center), leaving a 125 px gap under the 'New post' row at 390 x 844 (light and dark). Must sit right under the header (<= 32 px). Tests: app/src/screens/__tests__/shareStart.test.tsx GUX-T2, app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js GUX-T2

GUX-T6 P2 (PR #174 fix round, Nov 24): on the demo at 390 x 844 Gallery's birthday card 'Not now' starts under the floating tab bar, and the least scroll that reveals it (keyboard focus, screen reader) leaves it under the bar (bottom 844 vs bar top 764). The scroll content has room (paddingBottom 32 + tab bar), but the web scroll area needs its bottom inset as scroll padding. Test: app/e2e-web/demo.spec.js GUX-T6
